When_Not_To_Use: Stage 0-1: Don't design hi-fi before validating problem
Warning: Using Figma for detailed mockups when you should be doing customer interviews

When_Not_To_Use: When team collaboration is needed — Sketch is Mac-only
Warning: Choosing single-platform tool for distributed team

When_Not_To_Use: Don't use as primary product analytics tool
Warning: Notion cannot replace PostHog/Mixpanel for event tracking

When_Not_To_Use: Stage 0-2: Don't use project management tools before you have things to manage
Warning: Overcomplicating with PM tools when you have 0 tasks

When_Not_To_Use: Stage 4+: Trello doesn't scale for engineering teams
Warning: Simple kanban breaks down with >10 active items

When_Not_To_Use: When you need websockets or long-running processes
Warning: Vercel serverless functions timeout at 10s (hobby) / 60s (pro)

When_Not_To_Use: When you need complex user auth or database logic
Warning: Webflow is for marketing sites not web apps

When_Not_To_Use: Don't use for SaaS products — Shopify is for physical/digital goods
Warning: Forcing SaaS into e-commerce platform

When_Not_To_Use: When you need graph database or complex NoSQL queries
Warning: Supabase is Postgres — use MongoDB/Neo4j for graph/document models

When_Not_To_Use: When you need complex SQL queries or relational data
Warning: NoSQL = no joins. If your data is relational pick Supabase/Postgres

When_Not_To_Use: At Stage 5+ when you need enterprise SLAs
Warning: Railway is great for MVPs but lacks enterprise compliance features

When_Not_To_Use: Stage 4+: Heroku free tier removed and pricing increased significantly
Warning: Cost increases rapidly compared to alternatives like Railway/Vercel

When_Not_To_Use: When your market doesn't support Stripe (some APAC/African countries)
Warning: Check Stripe availability in target market BEFORE building payment flow

When_Not_To_Use: Stage 0-3: Overkill before you have meaningful event volume
Warning: Segment adds complexity without value when you have <1000 MAU

When_Not_To_Use: Stage 0-2: Don't set up retention analytics before you have users to retain
Warning: Complex analytics setup with 0 users = wasted time

When_Not_To_Use: When you have <100 daily visitors — sample too small for meaningful heatmaps
Warning: Heatmap data is noise with tiny traffic

When_Not_To_Use: Stage 0-2: CRM is premature when you have 0 customers
Warning: HubSpot is powerful but adds overhead before you need it

When_Not_To_Use: Stage 0-2: Don't add customer support tool before having customers
Warning: Setting up chatbot when nobody is visiting your site

When_Not_To_Use: Stage 0-2: Don't invest in SEO tools before you have content to optimize
Warning: SEO investment without content strategy = wasted money

When_Not_To_Use: When you need low-latency or high-volume automations
Warning: Zapier has execution delays and per-task pricing that scales poorly

When_Not_To_Use: Stage 0-3: Don't add subscription management before you have subscribers
Warning: Complex billing infra with 0 paying customers

When_Not_To_Use: When sharing openly — DocSend is for tracked confidential sharing
Warning: Using DocSend for blog posts or public content defeats the purpose

When_Not_To_Use: Stage 4+: No-code rarely scales past 1000 users without performance issues
Warning: Bubble has scaling limitations — migrate to code for growth stage

When_Not_To_Use: When you need deterministic outputs — LLMs are probabilistic
Warning: Don't use ChatGPT as a decision-making engine for critical business logic

When_Not_To_Use: For B2B enterprise products — PH audience is consumer/developer-oriented
Warning: Launching enterprise product on PH gets wrong audience

When_Not_To_Use: Stage 0: Don't vibe-code before identifying a clear problem to solve
Warning: Building random AI-generated apps without a validated problem = fast road to nowhere

When_Not_To_Use: Stage 1-2: Don't add animations/particles/juice before any user has tried the core product
Warning: Polishing UX for 0 users. Build core → ship → THEN polish based on what users actually use

When_Not_To_Use: Stage 0-6: Building with AI but never deploying = zero validation
Warning: AI makes building easy but the VALUE is in shipping. Undeployed code = inventory waste

When_Not_To_Use: Stage 2: Don't survey potential users when you already have a working product to let them try
Warning: In AI era you can build faster than survey. Let them TRY it instead of asking if they WOULD use it

When_Not_To_Use: Stage 1-3: Don't build Rust+WASM+microservices for an unvalidated idea
Warning: AI enables complex architecture but complex ≠ validated. Match architecture to stage not ambition
